name: Brilliance China Automotive Holdings Limited
summary: Brilliance China Automotive Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells BMW vehicles, non-BMW vehicles, and automotive components in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It provides minibuses and multi-purpose vehicles. The company's automotive components include mouldings, seats, axles, safety and airbag systems, and interior decoration products, as well as engines for minibuses, sedans, sport utility vehicles, light duty trucks, etc. In addition, it provides BMW sport activity vehicles.
